name: 28983-batchdecode-dsv4flash-tp8
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the fp4-expert build. The repackaged sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 is a different serialization of the same architecture and is not a substitute here.
parallelism: World size 8 on one node: context-parallel attention (attn_cp_size 8, per-rank attention tensor-parallel width 1) with the 256 routed experts sharded across the same eight cards. PP=1, EP off.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM: 43 decoder layers, MLA-compressed KV, DeepSeek sparse attention, 256 routed experts at top-6 plus 1 shared, vocab 129280; the rest reads off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix reuse: exactly 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out, both pinned rather than left to spread, at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos true.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a sparse trillion-class model, 32 concurrent users, 1024-token prompts and replies, eight GPUs.
launch:
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 8

# Load-bearing pair: deprecated spellings, migrated at argument resolution, that put attention in
# context parallel for this architecture (`attn_cp_size` = world size). Without them the server
# still starts and still serves, on a different attention layout -- confirm `attn_cp_size=8` in
# the launch log. The hook also asserts world size <= 8, which pins this to one node.
enable-nsa-prefill-context-parallel: true
nsa-prefill-cp-mode: round-robin-split

moe-runner-backend: marlin
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Both stay at or above the 32 streams in flight: the admission cap must not decide the batch, and
# the CUDA-graph capture ladder must reach the batch actually in flight.
max-running-requests: 64
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
